top_findings: F1: Sitemap and robots.txt point to non-www, causing 308 redirect loops for all index entries.
F3: Invalid relative hreflang links and missing x-default in layout.
F4: Zero structured data (LocalBusiness, Organization, Product schema missing).
F5: Missing Open Graph and Twitter card meta tags.
quick_wins: Create src/app/llms.txt/route.js for AI search readiness

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Server-rendered HTML (no JS dependency for crawlability)

findings.title: Sitemap & Robots Host Mismatch
findings.description: Sitemap and robots.txt reference non-www URL while live site canonical is www (308 redirect loop).
findings.recommendation: Update NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL in .env.live and Vercel to https://www.matoshreefruits.com

findings.title: Missing Canonical Tags
findings.description: Zero canonical tags found across all 15 rendered locale pages.
findings.recommendation: Configure metadataBase and canonical links in src/app/[locale]/layout.js

findings.title: Invalid Hreflang Alternates
findings.description: Hreflang links use relative paths (/hi, /mr) without metadataBase or x-default.
findings.recommendation: Add absolute alternates and x-default in layout.js

findings.title: Missing Security Headers
findings.description: Missing X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options, and CSP.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Multi-lingual support (Hindi, Marathi, English) with natural phrasing
Clear WhatsApp CTA and farmer-direct value proposition

findings.title: Brand-Only Homepage Title
findings.description: Homepage title is brand-only ('मातोश्री फ्रूट्स'), missing key trade modifiers.
findings.recommendation: Update locale JSON title templates to include wholesale keywords.

findings.title: Zero Structured Data
findings.description: No LocalBusiness, Organization, Product, or BreadcrumbList schema on any page.
findings.recommendation: Inject JSON-LD graph in root layout and page components per findings/schema.md.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Fast LCP (1.7s mobile) and low TBT (50ms)

findings.title: Desktop CLS Footer Shift
findings.description: Desktop CLS 0.429 caused by unreserved footer height.
findings.recommendation: Add min-height to footer element in src/app/[locale]/components/Footer.js

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All major AI search and training crawlers allowed in robots.txt
Clear NAP and pricing policy in SSR text

findings.title: Missing llms.txt and Markdown Delivery
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404 and no markdown content negotiation exists.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Update NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to https://www.matoshreefruits.com in .env.live and Vercel
Add metadataBase and canonical tags in layout.js
Fix hreflang absolute URLs and add x-default
Inject LocalBusiness and Organization JSON-LD schema

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Fix desktop footer CLS in Footer.js
Update homepage title with wholesale keyword modifiers

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Claim and optimize Google Business Profile at Sarola, Burhanpur
Register on Tier 1 Indian B2B directories (IndiaMART, Justdial)
Add FAQ schema blocks for wholesale buyers

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Monitor GSC indexation and warning clearance
Track organic search impressions for banana wholesale terms
